title: polifolia montana var. latifolia
intro: Polifolia montana var. latifolia, commonly known as bog rosemary, is a type of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of bog rosemary include sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it useful for treating conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of bog rosemary include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
